name: Alejandro Ramirez
bio:
Alejandro's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the roar of engines at the local go-kart track in Guadalajara. He pursued a degree in marketing, always with the goal of combining his passion for racing with his professional skills. After graduating, he interned with a smaller racing team, gaining invaluable experience in sponsorship acquisition and brand management. He joined Crown Racing two years ago, bringing with him a fresh perspective and a talent for crafting compelling marketing campaigns. 

Alejandro's approach to marketing is deeply data-driven, but he also believes in the power of storytelling to connect with fans on an emotional level. He is known for his ability to adapt to changing market trends and his calm demeanor under pressure, making him an invaluable asset to the team. He distinguishes himself through his knack for identifying emerging marketing channels and his commitment to delivering measurable results.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Alejandro is of average height with a lean build and a friendly, approachable face.
